minimal_execution_DAG_proposal: A: approved bounded measurement/smoke specification and contract, both independent pre-code gates; settle early-scope boundary, count ambiguity and explicit resource ceiling.
B after A: verify pinned official installation/runtime/extension docs; select one common supported runtime/model or preregister runtime strata and causal limitation.
C after A: independent evaluator selects five task fixtures, validates runnable public/hidden oracles and seals identities before any candidate run.
D after B: construct isolated method-faithful adapters and accounting; independent fidelity review of all four arms, with documented supported workflows.
E after C+D: static identity/leak/ownership checks, synthetic trace replay and scoring mutation controls; actual host preflight. This is zero model-task spend.

F after E plus all contractual prerequisites/approvals: freeze paired order, setup convention, injection points, all caps, exclusions and at-most-one infrastructure rerun rule; commit preregistration and seals.
G after F: execute exactly approved assigned matrix in separate roots/state/caches, publish all attempts including non-passing unsupported/timeout/budget-exhausted/abandoned outcomes.
H after G: independent scoring/reconstruction, descriptive diagnostic report and bottleneck ranking; no superiority or novice-ease claim. Pilot expansion needs its own funded authorization.
missing_runnable_artifacts: Task manifest: five exact repository URLs/local immutable bundles, base commits/trees, task prompts, permitted changes, language/toolchain and lockfile hashes, build dependencies and deterministic clarification answers.

Per-task commands: public build/test command, environment/setup command, independent hidden-oracle invocation and expected pass/fail exit semantics; none is supplied by the current comparison evidence.

Ground truth: evaluator independently checks oracle accepts known-correct solution and rejects planted defect/regression/false-completion/unauthorized-write/secret-exposure cases; report actual control runs, never hypothetical passes.

Recovery fixture: executable fault trigger and semantic checkpoint detector, persisted-state commitment, expected recovery condition, allowed operator action and evidence that interruption was actually delivered.

Four adapter manifests: immutable package/source/config/extension identities, documented invocations, prompt entrypoints, allowed skills/tool policy, worktree/reset/cleanup commands and observed actual exits.

Separate trust boundary: evaluator/oracle storage inaccessible to all contestants and subagents; seal task/public/hidden hashes and retain protected bodies for independent reproduction. A hash without access isolation is insufficient.
Fidelity verdicts: independent reviewer verifies task-appropriate methods, supported runtime and equivalent public inputs; unsupported arm is recorded, never silently replaced or removed.
Preregistration seal: task/adapter/candidate/model/analysis hashes, randomized paired order/seed policy, denominator/exclusion/rerun rules, time origin and resource ceilings before unblinding.

Analysis artifact: synthetic known effects/nulls validate aggregation, failure denominators, overlapping time/subagent accounting, costs and missing-data handling. Smoke estimates are descriptive; confirmation bounds cannot be inferred from twenty runs.
fixed_resources_still_unknown: Exact provider/model snapshot, reasoning setting, context limit and supported shared runtime; authentication/subscription/API availability and licensing/installation compatibility are unverified.
Pinned runtime and executable versions, OS/hardware/image, toolchain/dependencies, network/filesystem/sandbox policy and actual capable-host receipts.
Aggregate per-task all-agent input/output/token/dollar/wall-time ceilings, maximum parallelism, setup budget, global campaign ceiling, pricing currency/date/rates and cache read/write accounting.
All arms must receive equal aggregate budgets including subagents; freeze cold setup versus warm use and identical retry/cache policies. No framework receives free hidden setup or uncounted workers.
No monetary amount, funded host, model snapshot or paid-call permission is established by this audit. Missing fields remain null/unknown and prevent an efficiency-win claim.
telemetry_contract_needed: For every assigned run/stage/attempt: arm/task/family IDs, exact revisions/digests, model/settings, parent/subagent IDs, prompts/tool events, UTC starts/ends plus monotonic elapsed time, actual exit and terminal status.

Capture input/output/cache tokens and provider usage/cost receipts with price identity; count all agents once, union overlapping intervals for elapsed time, retain billed failures/retries and artifacts by path.
Record active operator minutes/intervention count/reason, infrastructure wait, repeats, rework cause and artifact bytes; distinguish observed intervention logs from measured human ease of use.

Evaluator reports hidden-check task success, critical violations, recovery success and diagnostic time/token/cost distributions on all assigned and jointly successful pairs; undefined ratios/quantiles remain explicit.
No novice participants are authorized/recruited here. Synthetic replay and agents cannot be presented as real novices; the proposed twelve-person counterbalanced study is separate future work.
